column1: # gates.tsv — this repo's CI steps, for /ci-triage's ci-triage-state.sh. The repo's own file.
# One line per gate, columns separated by a single tab:
# step pattern       a shell glob matched against the failed step's name as the run shows it
#                    (`gh run view <id> --json jobs`), e.g. Run lint suite, Install*
# category           a short word for the kind of failure: lint-fail, build-fail, test-fail,
#                    secret-leak, toolchain-fail, ... The first matching line wins.
# sub-check pattern  for a step that wraps several checks: an extended regex the step's log ends
#                    with before the name of the check that failed; the text after its last match
#                    is reported as the sub-check. - when the step runs one check.
# banner             one line printed as BANNER: when the obvious fix is the wrong one (a secret
#                    finding: rotate the credential first; a security baseline: never extend it
#                    just to turn the gate green).
